session_policy.notes: Best/explanation languages may come from all canonical learn-from languages. Practice targets only Tier 1 and Tier 2 learning languages with knowledge-set records. Hemisphere, climate, and cultural season systems are runtime context and must not be inferred from a bare language tag.

triggers.notes: Offer as an early dates/time vocabulary and culture lesson for eligible learning languages.

constraints.task: put the selected season system in cycle order
match season concepts to target-language terms
identify the season before or after a named season when the selected system is cyclic

presentation.scroll_mode: render groups in one vertical lesson surface
presentation.pages_mode: render each group as one or more full-screen pages according to block page_break/group metadata
presentation.teacher_presentation_mode: use the same groups and data with classroom-sized controls; do not fork lesson content
